# Commit email fixtures

Recorded by hand on 2026-11-27 from the keyless APIs of gitlab.com and codeberg.org (the
requests are in the docstring of `modules/commit_emails.py`), then cut down. Every person,
handle, address, repository, ID and hash in them is invented; the shape and the field names
are the API's own. Gitea.com answers in the Codeberg shape, so its tests use the Codeberg
files. The tests never use the network.
